failure.title: Coverage collected a Node-native resolver regression as an empty Vitest suite
failure.note: The retained configuration, coverage orchestrator, Node-native test, and command summary show Vitest reporting no suite in database-error.runtime.test.mjs after the Node runner had already passed it; 42 Vitest files and 488 tests passed before collection aborted.
failure.diagnosis: The backend coverage scope selected the complete src tree, so Vitest collected a deliberate node:test ESM resolver regression solely because its filename ended in .test.mjs. The file correctly had no Vitest suite.

rawEvidence.policy: Raw captures remain immutable in the developer-local vault; this public summary retains reviewed failure facts and cryptographic provenance without publishing browser traces, videos, logs, or mutation payloads.
